title: Gaaddisa Damee Damee Jala
intro: Oduu durii lubbuu osoo hin dhalatin adda baafamtee, dallaa qulqulluu keessatti guddifamtee fi mallattoo addunyaan argitee hin beekne qabachuuf filatte kan mul’atudha. Himannaan kallattii hundaan yeroo ka’u, bakka baay’ee hin fakkaanne irraa sagalee shakkii hunda callisu tokko dhufe. Eenyu akka gaaddisa damee jala deeme argachuu dandeessaa?
clues: Hafuura koo isa jalqabaa osoon hin baafatin dura tajaajila isa hundumaa danda’uuf of kenneera, kunis waadaa namni na baatee ture.
Golee qulqulluu iddoo waaqeffannaa tokkoo keessatti eegduu qajeelaa tokkoo jalatti kunuunsa dammaqinaan guddadhe.
Eegduun koo gara kutaa koo yeroo dhufu hundatti, yeroowwan taʼuu hin qabne irraa rizqii na bira argata ture.
Haalli koo wanta abdachiifameef bakka kan hin dhiifne taʼus, waaʼee ilma koo oduu gammachiisaa naaf kenname.
Bakka fagootti of duuba deebiʼee, achittis damee tokko gaaddisa naaf kenne, utuu sulula tokko jala yaaʼu.
Himannaan dhufee gaaffiin na marsee yeroo mucaa koo reefuu dhalatetti akeeke — inni immoo shakkii hunda callisuuf siree irraa dubbate.

arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
verse: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. (19:24)
